## Daywhisper {{VERSION}} candidate

Daywhisper is the new name for My Tasks — Enchanted Forest. Existing local planner data is retained. Export a backup before upgrading; older versions cannot read the new schema.

- Google Calendar removed; reminders remain local and work while the app runs, including tray mode.
- Two new themes: Midnight Observatory and Amber Hearth.
- Study revision planner and Creator, Freelancer, Habits and Journal packs.
- Automatic local backups and safety snapshots before restore.
- Idle scheduler no longer writes unchanged state every second.
- Feedback form and Microsoft Store commerce integration prepared.

Preview builds unlock packs for testing. Purchases, feedback delivery and sponsorship are inactive until configured. This is not a Microsoft Store certified release. Native device testing, account setup and artwork rights review remain required.

The Windows desktop installer is unsigned. Store preview packages cannot be submitted under a real app identity. Review the publishing checklist before distributing beyond testing.
